name: @red-cup-engineering/capability-cell-fabrication-run-history-migrator-service
description: Receipt-bearing migration of fabrication JSONL histories into canonical semantic carriers and evidence-resolved stage laws.

scripts.check: node --check src/migrate-run-history.mjs && node --check src/migrate-acceptance-pulse-proof-pore.mjs && node --check bin/migrate-run-history.mjs && node --check bin/migrate-acceptance-pulse-proof-pore.mjs

migrate-capability-cell-fabrication-run-.input: one immutable directory of JSONL run histories, one absent target directory, optional exact expected-before corrections, and optional evidence predicates for overloaded historical stage laws
migrate-capability-cell-fabrication-run-.output: RMN-identified replacement histories, exact CBOR carriers, evidence-resolved stage laws, and one source-to-target migration receipt
migrate-capability-cell-fabrication-run-.refusal: source corruption, target collision, broken source causality, in-place rewrite, correction mismatch, ambiguous evidence, or invalid stage-law migration
